description: Fetch image bytes for up to 5 imageDbIds and return them inline as `type: image` content blocks. Falls back to the metadata `imageURL` when the server lacks dedicated image-content delivery. No filesystem side-effects.

alias.description: Connection alias registered via brapi_connect. Omit to read the connection registered under alias `default` — i.e. a prior brapi_connect call that did not specify an alias. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

name: brapi_get_image

alias.description: Alias of the registered BrAPI connection the call used.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection has been registered under the requested alias. `images_unsupported`: BrAPI server does not advertise /images in /serverinfo. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

errors.description: Images that could not be loaded, one entry per id.

items.description: Per-image error entry returned when a fetch fails.

error.description: Reason the image could not be loaded.

imageDbId.description: Image identifier the error applies to.

imageHeight.description: Pixel height. Coerced from string when the upstream emits a numeric string.

imageWidth.description: Pixel width. Coerced from string when the upstream emits a numeric string.

observationUnitDbId.description: FK to the observation unit this image depicts.

observationUnitName.description: Display name of the observation unit.

studyDbId.description: FK to the study the image belongs to.

mimeType.description: Actual MIME type of the returned bytes.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the returned byte payload.

warnings.description: Per-image advisories for loaded payloads that appear suspect — e.g. the imageURL fallback returned a non-image MIME type, suggesting the upstream URL is broken.

items.description: Per-image advisory for loaded-but-suspect content (e.g. non-image MIME).

imageDbId.description: Image identifier the warning applies to.

warning.description: Advisory — bytes loaded but something is suspect.

title: Brapi Get Image
